images.description: Cancel flow final step at the largest accessibility text size, light: main (left) overflows and pushes Cancel Subscription off screen; this PR (right) keeps Stay for 50% off and Cancel Subscription pinned. iPhone 17 Pro simulator.
Cancel flow feedback step at the largest text size, dark: main (left) hides Continue and Skip for Now under an overflow; this PR (right) keeps both on screen. iPhone 17 Pro simulator.

30-day trial offer sheet at the largest text size after swiping up: main (left) cannot scroll and Claim and No thanks stay off screen; this PR (right) scrolls to the price terms, Claim and No thanks. iPhone 17 Pro simulator.
Cancel flow final step at default text with this PR, light (left) and dark (right); visually identical to main (PSNR above 90 dB). iPhone 17 Pro simulator.
30-day trial offer sheet at default text with this PR, light (left) and dark (right); byte-identical to main's screenshots. iPhone 17 Pro simulator.
